subject: LIVE guest evidence for #101 (console keyboard input) and #102 (host-requested orderly shutdown) on the VirtualBuddy generic EFI platform
loader_amendment: loader-rx-post-driver-ok.patch — REQUIRED for live boot; the original console-input loader patch wedges the VZ virtio console by printing/notifying before DRIVER_OK (bisect in loader-build.json). The four reviewed patches are untouched; this is an additional change the coordinator may want to fold into xnu-loader-virtualbuddy-console-input.patch.

serial_shows: loader lines 'Virtio console TX prepared' and 'Virtio console RX prepared notify=0x100044000 queue=0x75CC4000'
typed 'echo hello-issue-101' echoed by the tty and executed: output line 'hello-issue-101'
line editing: typed 'echo blauX', 0x7f backspace erased X, 'os' + CR; the shell executed 'echo blauos' and printed 'blauos'

'sleep 30' echoed and started; 0x03 echoed as ^C but did NOT interrupt sleep (no prompt returned); the typed line 'echo shell-alive-after-ctrl-c' stayed queued in the tty input buffer and executed only when sleep exited on its own ('# shell-alive-after-ctrl-c')
after 0x04 (^D) the typed line 'echo post-eof-must-not-run' was echoed by the line discipline but never executed (no output line): the shell took EOF

CORRECTION (later runs): the original reading 'Ctrl-C returned the console to the shell' is wrong. run-2/full-session prove the line discipline consumes ^C (echoctl only) but delivers no SIGINT to the foreground process: a foreground cat kept consuming input until EOF. A pending cooked line is NOT discarded by ^C (the shell-alive line above executed after sleep exited naturally). See checkpoint-live.json

issue_101.path: host console_input.py -> probe console-input.fifo -> VZ serial read handle -> virtio console RX queue 0 (loader-posted buffer) -> pe_serial rd0/rr0 -> serial_keyboard_poll (serial=3) -> cons_cinput -> /dev/console tty -> /bin/sh -i
caveats: Ctrl-C (0x03) in these runs did NOT deliver SIGINT to the foreground guest process (foreground cat survived ^C in full-session; sleep 30 ran on here); root cause: launchd opens job fds with O_NOCTTY before setsid(), so the console tty never gained a foreground process group. FIXED in run-3 (see checkpoint-live.json sigint_fix_run_3): the consoleshell job now execs via usr/libexec/blauos-console-login (TIOCSCTTY + tcsetpgrp), and live run-3 shows cat interrupted by Ctrl-C and vim leaving insert mode on Ctrl-C
A cooked line pending in the tty input queue survives ^C and executes when the foreground process exits naturally (input-run2)
EOF has no guest-visible 'exit' banner; evidence is that subsequent input is echoed but never executed
USB keyboard remains unsupported (no XHCI/HID stack); input enters through the virtio serial RX queue only

issue_102.no_force_stop: result.json records no orderly-shutdown-timeout, no force-stop-recovery and no host-stopped-probe event
serial_shows: launchd: 'System: Userspace shutdown took approximately 20 seconds.'
issue_102.route: requestStop -> ARMH0061 PL061 GPIO pin 6 -> kernel 100 ms RIS poll (puredarwin-virtualbuddy-power-button.patch) -> SIGTERM to PID 1 -> launchd child cleanup + unmount -> PSCI SYSTEM_OFF -> public guestDidStop

note: VM results on the generic EFI platform; no physical Apple Silicon console input or shutdown is claimed (Gate 2 not run).
